description: This file contains implementation of SHA-256 hash functions, including initialization, transformation, update, and finalization routines, specific to the sha256 block processing in a cryptographic context.

methods.name: blk_SHA256_Init
methods.description: Initializes SHA256 context with starting values and zero offsets.

methods.name: blk_SHA256_Transform
methods.description: Performs the core SHA-256 transformation on a 512-bit block.

methods.name: blk_SHA256_Update
methods.description: Updates SHA256 context with new data, processing in 64-byte blocks.

methods.name: blk_SHA256_Final
methods.description: Finalizes the SHA256 hash, applying padding and producing the digest.
